revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2024 growth 8.6% and FY2025 6.2% (from filed revenue) fade toward mature pharma growth as exclusivity losses offset pipeline/Dupixent growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: reported EBIT margin 18.4% FY2023, 17.7% FY2024, 14.5% FY2025 (filed figures); 17% assumes partial recovery toward the 3-year average (~16.9%).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. French statutory corporate rate range / long-run effective rate; Damodaran Europe pharma average effective rate (7.8%) judged too low for a sustainable rate.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: D&A history not found in the data tool; set slightly below capex % as a placeholder for reviewer to verify against the filing's cash-flow statement.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: filed capex/revenue 7.7% FY2023, 7.8% FY2024, 8.1% FY2025; modest normalisation.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 3.266% (ECB 10Y AAA, 2026-11-05) + relevered beta 1.224 (Damodaran Europe pharma unlevered cash-corrected 1.086, D/E 0.159, tax 20%) x France ERP 5.006% = Ke 9.39%; Kd pre-tax 5.74% (Damodaran) x (1-20%); weights 86.3/13.7 (Damodaran industry).

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 3.27% EUR risk-free rate and long-run euro nominal GDP growth; mature pharma.
